info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Parsley Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Parsley Notebook Detail Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed entries for Parsley notebooks in their catalog. By facilitating the addition of comprehensive details about each notebook, this API supports efficient inventory management and enhances customer engagement. Retailers and catalog managers can utilize these endpoints to ensure that accurate descriptions and specifications are available for their products. This API streamlines the cataloging process and improves the overall user experience for consumers browsing through the notebook offerings.

post.summary: Create a new detail for a parsley notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry related to a specific parsley notebook, facilitating better organization and management of notebook content.
